summary.selection_note: Exploratory replication on folds 0, 1, and 3 requested after viewing binary fold outcomes and the multiclass fold-0 seed-46 pilot. These selected folds are not an unbiased full cross-validation estimate. All nine new comparisons are retained regardless of outcome; the seed-46 pilot is excluded from aggregate results. Patient identities are unavailable.
